name: webwright-text-vision
description: Webwright adapted for Codex Spark: use a text default model for DOM-first Playwright work and a vision fallback only for screenshot judgment.

interface.longDescription: Runs Webwright-style browser automation with a text default model such as gpt-5.3-codex-spark, reserving vision-capable models for screenshot inspection and final visual verification.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Webwright in text default mode with vision fallback only when screenshot inspection is necessary.
